issue_title: ValueError raised when parsing empty config file
issue_body:
When config.yaml is empty, load_config() throws a raw ValueError instead of returning default settings. Expected: should fall back to DEFAULT_CONFIG.

Steps to reproduce:
1. touch config.yaml
2. load_config('config.yaml')
3. Traceback...
difficulty_notes: Easy — single function, clear repro steps, one test file to touch. Good sanity-check task.
